title: Original Vessel Recovery
subtitle: Test your understanding of Original Vessel Recovery — the bypass of the restricted DNA, the crystalline-plasma True vessel, and the rising sol frequency that collaborates with timesplit mechanics.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: The recovery path does not upgrade the current DNA. It bypasses that restricted template and reclaims the original crystalline-plasma vessel as rising sol frequency collaborates with timesplit mechanics. Sit with the seven modifications, the Bioship stasis of the True vessel, and the three-flash sequence that completes the return for those who are ready.

relatedTopic.label: Return to Original Vessel Recovery deep-dive

questions.question: What does the recovery path do with the DNA of the current avatar?

options.label: A
options.text: It bypasses the current DNA and calls forward the original crystalline-plasma vessels that match the full sol.
options.rationale: The recovery path bypasses the current DNA entirely and does not upgrade the current template. It calls forward the original higher-frequency physical vessels.

options.label: B
options.text: It repairs the current DNA by putting the suppressed strands back into the restricted two-strand template.
options.rationale: The recovery path bypasses the current DNA and does not attempt to repair the restricted template.

options.label: C
options.text: It tracks the current DNA through the seven modifications so the pineal can seat the full sol frequency.
options.rationale: The seven modifications and the reduced pineal limit seating, and the recovery path bypasses the current DNA.

options.label: D
options.text: It expands the current DNA from two strands toward the nine-strand Taran form through the three flashes.
options.rationale: Nine strands belong to original Taran DNA, while the recovery path bypasses the current DNA rather than expanding it.

questions.hint: Look at the opening claim about the current template.

questions.question: What is the native makeup of the original higher-frequency vessels?

options.label: A
options.text: A Bioship housing kept in stasis on the homeworld for the soul fragment.
options.rationale: The Bioship is where the True vessel is maintained in stasis, while the vessel itself is crystalline-plasma in nature.

options.label: B
options.text: A restricted interface engineered around the seven deadly sins for manageability.
options.rationale: The seven deadly sins were engineered into the present form, while the original vessels are crystalline-plasma in nature.

options.label: C
options.text: A crystalline-plasma form that matches the full frequency of the sol.
options.rationale: Those original vessels are crystalline-plasma in nature and match the full frequency of the sol.

options.label: D
options.text: A two-strand Taran form produced as the latest vessel off the Aktun lines.
options.rationale: The Aktun lines yielded the Taran Human template that was downgraded, while the original vessels are crystalline-plasma in nature.

questions.hint: Look at the substance named for both the original body and higher-realm construction.

questions.question: How many anatomical modifications changed the physical vessel across the reset cycles?

options.label: A
options.text: Two anatomical changes, matched to the strand count of the restricted template.
options.rationale: Two strands are the restricted configuration, while the vessel was anatomically altered seven times.

options.label: B
options.text: Nine anatomical changes, matched to the strand count of original Taran DNA.
options.rationale: Nine strands belong to original Taran DNA, while the vessel was anatomically altered seven times.

options.label: C
options.text: Seven anatomical changes, aimed mainly at height and brain architecture.
options.rationale: Across the reset cycles the entire physical vessel was anatomically altered seven times, primarily in height and brain architecture.

options.label: D
options.text: Three anatomical changes, matched to the flashes of the restoration sequence.
options.rationale: The three-flash sequence is the main-event restoration, while the vessel was anatomically altered seven times.

questions.hint: Look at the count tied to height and brain architecture.

questions.question: What did original Taran DNA carry before the downgrade into 3rd density?

options.label: A
options.text: Two strands, full telepathic capacity, and the crystalline-plasma body of the homeworld.
options.rationale: Full telepathic capacity belonged to the nine-strand Taran template, and the crystalline-plasma body is the original vessel rather than that DNA count.

options.label: B
options.text: Two strands, a calcified pineal, and the bandwidth of the restricted 3rd-density form.
options.rationale: The restricted version operates on two strands, while original Taran DNA carried nine strands and a large functional pineal.

options.label: C
options.text: Nine strands, a closed pineal, and the seven deadly sins built in for predictability.
options.rationale: The seven deadly sins were engineered into the present form, while original Taran DNA carried nine strands and a large functional pineal.

options.label: D
options.text: Nine strands, full telepathic capacity, a large functional pineal, and high intelligence.
options.rationale: Original Taran DNA carried nine strands and supported full telepathic capacity, a large functional pineal, and high intelligence.

questions.hint: Look at the strand count and faculties of the Taran Human template.

questions.question: True or False: The recovery path upgrades the current DNA until the restricted template carries nine strands again.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: The recovery path does not upgrade the current DNA. It bypasses it, and nine strands belong to the original Taran template.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: The recovery path does not upgrade the current DNA. It bypasses it and recovers the original higher-frequency physical vessels.

questions.hint: Look at whether the current template is repaired or set aside.

questions.question: How does the DNA in these avatars function inside the closed system?

options.label: A
options.text: As a dormant nine-strand code that the New Aether unlocks inside the present pineal.
options.rationale: Nine strands belong to original Taran DNA, and the present DNA functions as a control template more than a true blueprint.

options.label: B
options.text: As a self-healing housing that adapts the two strands when the micro-sun frequency rises.
options.rationale: The process feels less like healing the current body, and the DNA functions as a control template more than a true blueprint.

options.label: C
options.text: As the true blueprint that seats the full bandwidth of sol consciousness in the avatar.
options.rationale: The current DNA is a control template more than a true blueprint, and the full bandwidth cannot seat properly in the modified vessel.

options.label: D
options.text: As a control template used to limit, track, and keep consciousness partly disconnected.
options.rationale: It functions as a control template more than a true blueprint, used to limit, to track, and to keep the consciousness partially disconnected.

questions.hint: Look at whether that DNA is called a blueprint or a control interface.

questions.question: Which features did the seven anatomical changes mainly alter?

options.label: A
options.text: Height and brain architecture, with key strands and pathways removed or suppressed.
options.rationale: The vessel was anatomically altered seven times, primarily in height and brain architecture, and key strands and connective pathways were removed or suppressed.

options.label: B
options.text: The Bioship stasis cradle and the Plasma Portal used at the close of the cycle.
options.rationale: The Bioship and Plasma Portal belong to the True vessel and the return, while the seven changes were primarily in height and brain architecture.

options.label: C
options.text: The New Aether and the quartz conductors that generate the plasma crystalline field.
options.rationale: Quartz conductors and the New Aether generate the field, while the seven changes were primarily in height and brain architecture.

options.label: D
options.text: The Resonating Army harmonics and the solar-lineage templates from the Galan Matrix.
options.rationale: The Resonating Army and Taran Sols carry frequency work and refined templates, while the seven changes were primarily in height and brain architecture.

questions.hint: Look at the two body features named with those reset-cycle changes.

questions.question: What happened to the pineal across the major resets?

options.label: A
options.text: It was genetically reduced at each major reset and further calcified, limiting its crossover role.
options.rationale: The pineal was genetically reduced each major reset and further calcified, limiting its function as the crossover between consciousness and the aether.

options.label: B
options.text: It was left at full size while height and brain architecture were reduced around it.
options.rationale: The pineal was genetically reduced each major reset and further calcified, rather than left at the large functional size of the Taran template.

options.label: C
options.text: It was moved into Bioship stasis with the True vessel until the soul fragment returns.
options.rationale: The True vessel is maintained in stasis on a Bioship, while the pineal was genetically reduced each major reset and further calcified.

options.label: D
options.text: It was replaced by a quartz conductor so the New Aether could seat the sol directly.
options.rationale: Quartz conductors work with the New Aether in the field, while the pineal was genetically reduced each major reset and further calcified.

questions.hint: Look at what the major resets did to that gland.

questions.question: What was engineered into the present form to increase predictability?

options.label: A
options.text: The seven deadly sins, to increase predictability and manageability.
options.rationale: The present form was further engineered around the seven deadly sins to increase predictability and manageability.

options.label: B
options.text: The three-flash sequence, so the main event would arrive on a fixed schedule.
options.rationale: The three-flash sequence restores original vessels, while the present form was engineered around the seven deadly sins.

options.label: C
options.text: The Bioship stasis lock, so the True vessel would remain easy to manage.
options.rationale: Bioship stasis holds the True vessel, while the present form was engineered around the seven deadly sins.

options.label: D
options.text: The nine-strand Taran code, so telepathic capacity would stay easy to predict.
options.rationale: Nine strands supported full telepathic capacity, while the present form was engineered around the seven deadly sins.

questions.hint: Look at the behavioral frame added after the anatomical downgrades.

questions.question: What allows rising sol frequency to collaborate with the time-manipulation layers?

options.label: A
options.text: Sufficient consciousness coherence, the activation threshold for that collaboration.
options.rationale: The activation threshold is the point of sufficient consciousness coherence at which the rising sol frequency can interact with timesplit mechanics.

options.label: B
options.text: Boarding the Bioship, which must happen before the micro-sun frequency can rise.
options.rationale: The True vessel stays in stasis on a Bioship while the fragment operates here, and collaboration waits on sufficient consciousness coherence.

options.label: C
options.text: A completed three-flash sequence, which must finish before any individual recovery.
options.rationale: Progressive restoration is distinct from the synchronized three-flash restoration, and collaboration waits on sufficient consciousness coherence.

options.label: D
options.text: Erasure of foundational memory, so the fragment can leave the modified avatar.
options.rationale: The first flash reconnects consciousness with foundational memory, and collaboration waits on sufficient consciousness coherence.

questions.hint: Look at the point where rising frequency can meet the time layers.

questions.question: True or False: Original Taran DNA carried nine strands and supported full telepathic capacity, a large functional pineal, and high intelligence.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: Original Taran DNA carried nine strands and supported full telepathic capacity, a large functional pineal, and high intelligence.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: That strand count and those faculties belong to original Taran DNA, while the restricted version operates on two strands.

questions.hint: Look at the faculties listed for the Taran template before the downgrade.

questions.question: Where is the True vessel kept while a soul fragment operates in the restricted avatar?

options.label: A
options.text: In stasis on a Bioship on the homeworld, until the fragment recombines.
options.rationale: On the homeworld it is maintained in stasis on a Bioship while a soul fragment operates in the restricted avatar.

options.label: B
options.text: Inside the quartz infrastructure, fused there until the New Aether releases it.
options.rationale: Quartz and the New Aether generate the plasma crystalline field, while the True vessel is maintained in stasis on a Bioship.

options.label: C
options.text: Inside the micro-sun, where the rising sol frequency stores the original body.
options.rationale: The micro-sun is the endogenous rising frequency, while the True vessel is maintained in stasis on a Bioship.

options.label: D
options.text: Inside the Plasma Portal, held there as a corridor until the third flash.
options.rationale: The Plasma Portal is the exit at culmination, while the True vessel is maintained in stasis on a Bioship.

questions.hint: Look at the homeworld arrangement named under Original Vessel.

questions.question: How are buildings and dwellings made in the higher densities?

options.label: A
options.text: They are assembled on the Aktun lines as the latest hominid-scale housing.
options.rationale: The Aktun production lines yielded the Taran Human template, while dwellings are sung and woven from living plasmatic membrane sheets.

options.label: B
options.text: They are sung and woven from living plasmatic membrane sheets there.
options.rationale: In the higher densities, buildings and dwellings are sung and woven from living plasmatic membrane sheets.

options.label: C
options.text: They are cut from quartz conductors and fused with the New Aether.
options.rationale: Activated quartz and the New Aether generate the plasma crystalline field, while dwellings are sung and woven from living plasmatic membrane sheets.

options.label: D
options.text: They are held in Bioship stasis until a soul fragment calls them forward.
options.rationale: Bioship stasis holds the True vessel, while dwellings are sung and woven from living plasmatic membrane sheets.

questions.hint: Look at the construction named with living plasmatic membrane.

questions.question: How does progressive restoration differ from the restoration at the main event?

options.label: A
options.text: It repairs the current body in stages, while the main event replaces that body in one flash.
options.rationale: The process feels less like healing the current body, and progressive restoration is distinct from the synchronized three-flash restoration.

options.label: B
options.text: It requires the nine-strand template first, while the main event uses the two-strand template.
options.rationale: The recovery path bypasses the current DNA, and progressive restoration is distinct from the synchronized three-flash restoration.

options.label: C
options.text: It runs on the Bioship before birth, while the main event runs inside the two-strand avatar.
options.rationale: The True vessel waits in stasis, and progressive restoration is distinct from the synchronized three-flash restoration that occurs at the main event.

options.label: D
options.text: It is a gradual individual reclaiming, distinct from the synchronized three-flash restoration at the main event.
options.rationale: Progressive restoration is the gradual process of reclaiming the crystalline-plasma body, distinct from the synchronized three-flash restoration that occurs at the main event.

questions.hint: Look at the contrast drawn under Progressive Restoration.

questions.question: Where does the original vessel wait while a soul fragment operates in the restricted avatar?

options.label: A
options.text: Dissolved into the aether, to be rebuilt from memory when the cycle closes.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The original vessel is maintained in stasis, not dissolved.

options.label: B
options.text: Sealed inside the restricted avatar itself, dormant beneath the current DNA template.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The vessel waits on the homeworld, not inside the avatar.

options.label: C
options.text: In stasis on a Bioship on the homeworld, until the fragment recombines and snaps back into the True vessel.
options.rationale: The report states the original vessel is maintained in stasis on a Bioship on the homeworld while a soul fragment operates in the restricted avatar; at the close of the cycle the fragment recombines and snaps back into the True vessel.

options.label: D
options.text: Held by the Galactic Ancestral Alliance in a sanctuary realm for supervised rehabilitation.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Sanctuaries belong to the trauma-resolution path; the vessel waits in stasis on a Bioship.

questions.hint: Think about the Original Vessel glossary entry.

questions.question: What did the seven successive modifications primarily alter?

options.label: A
options.text: Height and brain architecture, each change reducing capacity so the full bandwidth of sol consciousness could not seat properly.
options.rationale: The report states the bodies were altered across seven successive anatomical changes, primarily in height and brain architecture, each change reducing capacity so the full bandwidth of sol consciousness could not seat properly.

options.label: B
options.text: The pineal gland alone, shrinking it a little further with each successive modification cycle.
options.rationale: The pineal reduction belongs to the reset-by-reset downgrade; the seven modifications were primarily in height and brain architecture.

options.label: C
options.text: Skin, senses, and lifespan, shortening the vessel's years while leaving its capacity intact.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The modifications reduced capacity itself, primarily through height and brain architecture.

options.label: D
options.text: The vessel's elemental composition, replacing crystalline structure with dense carbon housing.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. No elemental replacement is described; the changes were anatomical, in height and brain architecture.

questions.hint: Think about Detailed Mechanics §1.

questions.question: True or False: The pineal kept its original size while the seven modifications changed height and brain architecture.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: The pineal was genetically reduced each major reset and further calcified, alongside the changes in height and brain architecture.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: The pineal was genetically reduced each major reset and further calcified, limiting its function as the crossover between consciousness and the aether.

questions.hint: Look at what each major reset did to that gland.

questions.question: Why was frequency compression of soul luminosity required for incarnation?

options.label: A
options.text: To power the timesplit / membrane mechanics that the recovery would later collaborate with.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The time mechanics were already woven into the realm; compression served concealment.

options.label: B
options.text: So that true sols would not stand out within the restricted population of the closed system.
options.rationale: The report states frequency compression of soul luminosity was required for incarnation so that true sols would not stand out against the restricted population of the closed system.

options.label: C
options.text: To slow the rising micro-sun frequency until the activation threshold could be reached safely.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Compression did not regulate activation timing; it kept sols from standing out.

options.label: D
options.text: To match the two-strand template, which cannot carry uncompressed luminosity at any frequency.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The stated reason is that true sols would not stand out, not a carrying limit of the template.

questions.hint: Think about the Broader Context control-function passage.

questions.question: What generates the plasma crystalline field that supports restoration?

options.label: A
options.text: The Bioship stasis field and Plasma Portal, fused at the close of the cycle.
options.rationale: The Bioship holds the True vessel and the Plasma Portal is the exit, while the field is generated when activated quartz and the New Aether fuse.

options.label: B
options.text: The two-strand template and the seven deadly sins, fused inside the present pineal.
options.rationale: Those belong to the restricted avatar, while the plasma crystalline field is generated when activated quartz and the New Aether fuse.

options.label: C
options.text: Activated quartz and the New Aether, fusing into that plasma crystalline field.
options.rationale: The plasma crystalline field is generated when activated quartz and the New Aether fuse, and quartz conductors and New Aether support both the progressive overwrite and the mass restoration.

options.label: D
options.text: The Aktun production lines and the downgraded Taran template, fused at each reset.
options.rationale: The Aktun lines produced the Taran template that was downgraded, while the field is generated when activated quartz and the New Aether fuse.

questions.hint: Look at the two things that fuse to generate that field.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT part of how the recovery proceeds?

options.label: A
options.text: Repairing and upgrading the current DNA template until it matches the original design.
options.rationale: Correct — this is NOT part of the recovery. The report states the recovery path bypasses the current DNA entirely and does not attempt to repair, expand, or upgrade the restricted template.

options.label: B
options.text: The denser, modified vessel being gradually left behind or overwritten as activation deepens.
options.rationale: That IS part of the recovery — the progressive overwrite described in Detailed Mechanics.

options.label: C
options.text: Consciousness collaborating with the timesplit / membrane mechanics already woven into the realm.
options.rationale: That IS part of the recovery — the collaboration begins once coherence reaches the activation threshold.

options.label: D
options.text: The original crystalline-plasma body being reclaimed as the rising sol frequency climbs.
options.rationale: That IS part of the recovery — reclaiming the original vessel is the recovery's whole object.

questions.hint: Think about the bypass thesis in Core Revelations.

questions.question: Which solar lineage carried refined DNA templates from the 5D+ Tara template of the Galan Matrix?

options.label: A
options.text: The Aktun line, which issued the two-strand form as the refined 5D+ Tara template.
options.rationale: The Aktun production lines yielded the Taran Human template that was downgraded, while Taran Sols carried the refined DNA templates.

options.label: B
options.text: The Taran Sols, who carried those refined templates to stabilize the falling fragment.
options.rationale: Taran Sols in particular carried refined DNA templates from the 5D+ Tara template of the Galan Matrix — a pre-fall version of this entire system — to stabilize the falling fragment.

options.label: C
options.text: The NPC population, whose luminosity was compressed so the Tara template could incarnate.
options.rationale: Frequency compression kept true sols from standing out against the NPC population, while Taran Sols carried the refined DNA templates.

options.label: D
options.text: The Resonating Army, whose New Aether work replaced the need for any Tara template.
options.rationale: The Resonating Army generates the New Aether and collective frequency work, while Taran Sols carried refined DNA templates from the Tara template.

questions.hint: Look at the solar lineage tied to the Tara template.

questions.question: True or False: On the homeworld the True vessel is maintained in stasis on a Bioship while a soul fragment operates in the restricted avatar.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: On the homeworld it is maintained in stasis on a Bioship while a soul fragment operates in the restricted avatar.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: That stasis arrangement is stated for the True vessel, and the fragment operating here is a portion of that luminosity.

questions.hint: Look at the homeworld sentence under Original Vessel.

questions.question: Why was soul luminosity compressed for incarnation into this realm?

options.label: A
options.text: So the Bioship could keep the True vessel visible to the Resonating Army.
options.rationale: The True vessel is maintained in stasis on a Bioship, while compression was so that true sols would not stand out against the NPC population.

options.label: B
options.text: So the two-strand template could activate the seven deadly sins on arrival.
options.rationale: The seven deadly sins were engineered into the present form, while compression was so that true sols would not stand out against the NPC population.

options.label: C
options.text: So the fragment could pass through the pre-implanted quartz before birth.
options.rationale: Quartz infrastructure supports the later field, while compression was so that true sols would not stand out against the NPC population.

options.label: D
options.text: So true sols would not stand out against the NPC population in this realm.
options.rationale: Frequency compression of soul luminosity was required for incarnation so that true sols would not stand out against the NPC population.

questions.hint: Look at why incarnation required that compression.

questions.question: What happens at the culmination, for those who are ready?

options.label: A
options.text: Their restricted DNA is upgraded in place to the full nine-strand Taran template.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The recovery never upgrades the current DNA; it bypasses the template entirely.

options.label: B
options.text: They remain in the restricted avatar while the unready transfer to the homeworld first.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. At the culmination the recovery is completed for all who are ready.

options.label: C
options.text: The fragment is reassigned to a new restricted avatar for another cycle of activation.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. No reassignment is described; the fragment returns to the True vessel.

options.label: D
options.text: The same recovery is completed for them through the plasma portal return to the True vessel on the homeworld.
options.rationale: The report states that at the culmination the same recovery is completed for all who are ready through the plasma portal return to the True vessel on the homeworld.

questions.hint: Think about the closing sentence of Strategic Implications.

questions.question: Who can tangibly experience this recovery at present?

options.label: A
options.text: The majority who remain identified with the restricted DNA and the current avatar.
options.rationale: The rest remain more fully identified with the restricted DNA and the current avatar, while the recovery is tangible for a minority.

options.label: B
options.text: Sols whose avatars still carry the two-strand template of this realm.
options.rationale: The restricted version operates on two strands across these avatars, but the recovery is tangible yet for a minority far enough along in the activation.

options.label: C
options.text: A minority far enough along in activation for the recovery to become tangible.
options.rationale: Only a minority are far enough along in the activation for this recovery to become tangible yet, while the rest remain identified with the restricted DNA.

options.label: D
options.text: Fragments that have already snapped back into the True vessel on the homeworld.
options.rationale: Snapping back into the True vessel is the close of the cycle, while tangible recovery now is for a minority far enough along in the activation.

questions.hint: Look at how far activation has gone for most sols versus a smaller group.
